scope: Full Bazel //... plus six explicit manual canonical parser, filesystem, journal bridge and store targets. Predates persisted-limit and memory-wire changes.
source_manifest_scope: All tracked files except categorical evidence; symbolic links hash link text. No claim to enumerate every external tool/system input.

rust_summaries.qualification: Counts include cached target logs and are not an independent Cargo run or a count of unique scenarios.

build_event_receipt: Selected test summary fields archived without raw BEP command lines or file URIs; raw build-event artifact retained outside git.
limitations: Production factories still construct legacy runtime; passing tests is not canonical cutover.
No new full Cargo workspace run in this checkpoint.
Manual mTLS runs and syscall faults retain their separately bound receipts; ignored TLS case is not counted as this Bazel execution.
Later commits do not inherit these exact-source totals.
